definition: in a relaxed way, without any stress
description: An old stairwell with a curving iron banister, tiled walls and a stained glass window. Two young men carry a heavy teal velvet sofa on the stone stairs, one at the bottom and one at the top. A young woman lies stretched out on the sofa in a cream jumper and jeans, calmly reading a book, and puts her arm behind her head, completely relaxed. Moving boxes, a palm plant and a cushion on the stairs are around them.

to lift the sofa's lower end
